summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Smart Farming AI Assistant MVP. Backend APIs fully functional (6/6 tests passed). Frontend navigation, authentication, and forms working. Key issue: AI responses not displaying after form submission despite successful API calls.

ui_bugs.issue: AI responses from crop recommendation and disease detection forms are not displaying to users after form submission
ui_bugs.selector: Result cards or response display components

ui_bugs.issue: Logout button not visible when user is logged in

integration_issues.issue: Forms submit successfully and backend returns AI responses, but results are not rendered in the UI

missing_features.issue: No voice synthesis button found in the UI despite being mentioned in requirements

success_percentage.frontend: 75% (navigation and forms work, but AI results display and voice features missing)

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix AI response display issue in dashboard - backend APIs return correct responses but frontend is not rendering the results. Also implement missing voice synthesis functionality and fix logout button visibility.
